text.csvIdentifier: The internalsensorid column must contain the internal Sensor ID (a number). Do not use the Device ID, External Device ID, or External Sensor ID.
text.whereToFindCsvIdentifier: Find this value in Administration → Devices → open the device → Sensors, under Internal Sensor ID. Each pollutant sensor has its own internal Sensor ID.
text.maximumFileSize: CSV files can be up to 5 MB. For larger imports, split the data into multiple uploads.
text.datetimeMustIso8601IfNo: Datetime must be ISO 8601. If no timezone is provided in the CSV, the sensor's device timezone from the database is applied.
text.fileMayIncludeMultipleDifferentSensor: A file may include measurements for multiple pollutant sensors. Use one row per sensor measurement and the matching internal Sensor ID for each row.
text.exampleLabel: Example (replace the IDs with the internal Sensor IDs shown for your sensors):
text.unitRequirement: CSV value must already be in the destination sensor’s configured unit. Confirm the sensor’s unit before uploading.
text.noConversion: The CSV format has no unit-conversion instruction. CompassAQ does not infer a different unit from the numeric value or convert the uploaded value.
text.updatePolicy: Duplicates follow the sensor’s Measurement Update Policy, then the device’s policy. Inherit with no Replace setting keeps existing values.
text.skippedExplanation: Skipped duplicates intentionally keep the existing value; they are not import failures.
text.timestampSemantics: Datetime follows the destination sensor’s configured timestamp meaning. If the meaning is unknown, confirm with the data owner whether the timestamp means interval start, interval end, or observation time before interpreting the data. Import preserves the sensor’s time basis and AQI requirements.
text.futureTolerance: Timestamps more than 5 minutes after CSV processing starts are rejected. Historical backfill is allowed.
text.qcExplanation: QC runs on inserted and updated values. Flag for review keeps a measurement valid; Mark invalid excludes it from valid-only calculations. Baseline Drift must be enabled and have sufficient valid history.
text.aqiMetadata: CSV uploads do not establish AQI eligibility. AQI also requires verified timing metadata supplied by an importer. Manually added sensors with unknown timing metadata can store measurements but may remain ineligible even with enough rows. Ask your administrator about a supported importer.
